about.photo_alt: Josh Woolsey, owner of Gorge Arbor Care, with the company truck
about.title: Josh Woolsey, ISA Certified Arborist
paragraphs: Josh started out in the tree industry over twenty years ago with Asplund Tree Experts as a line clearance arborist. After years of working for different companies in Oregon, he branched out on his own and started Gorge Arbor Care in 2019.

We're a locally owned family business, and Josh has strived to create a business that is local and affordable for everyone. He's an ISA Certified Arborist, and Gorge Arbor Care is licensed and bonded with the Construction Contractors Board and insured by State Farm.
Josh works alongside a hard-working crew: Justin, Troy and Devon. We work safely and effectively to meet your specific needs, and our estimates are always free.

services.name: Emergency & Storm Clean Up
services.blurb: Here for you 24/7 when a tree comes down or a storm hits.
services.intro: We understand how scary it can be with tree emergencies. If a tree falls on your property and causes damage, we will immediately come to you to provide assistance, day or night.
includes: 24/7 emergency tree removal and clean up
Tarping your roof and securing the building until repairs
Branch removal and full clean up of storm-damaged trees
Help with damaged fencing if needed
photos: Bucket truck working on a large tree

services.name: Tree Removal
services.blurb: Planned removal of unhealthy, damaged or unsightly trees.
services.intro: Our most common non-emergency service: a planned removal of unhealthy, nuisance, damaged or unsightly trees, using up-to-date rigging. Safety is our top priority on the job site.
photos: Climber working high in a birch tree

services.name: Pruning
services.blurb: Line clearing, selective pruning, fruit pruning and crown reduction.
services.intro: We prune to arboricultural standards and will advise you on what's best for each tree. We will not top trees, because it's unhealthy for the tree and creates more issues down the road, unless it's a fruit bearing tree.

services.name: Stump Grinding
services.blurb: Surface grinding or complete removal of the stump and roots.
services.intro: Surface grinding typically goes a couple of inches below grade. Full removal takes the stump and roots sixteen to twenty inches below grade.

services.name: Brush Clean Up
services.blurb: Brush from the job chipped and cleaned up.
services.intro: We clean up the brush that fell from the tree. This is typically done along with a removal, so your yard is left clean when we're done.
includes: Chipper and dump trailer on the job
photos: Chipper and dump trailer on a residential job

services.name: Lot Clearing
services.blurb: Trees cleared from lots so new homes can be built.
services.intro: We clear trees from lots so new homes can be built. This service covers the trees on the lot, not full land clearing.
includes: Tree removal on the building site
